content:
__**FAQ**__

**What is vibe/vibe?**
vibe/vibe is a permissionless launchpad on Robinhood Chain for launching, discovering, and trading new tokens.

**What do I need to launch a project on vibe/vibe testnet?**
Just an EVM Wallet and a very low amount of testnet funds on Robinhood Testnet chain.

**Where should builders start?**
Use <#1541735369265913899>, then <#1541735497527853148>.

**Where do I get testnet funds?**
Use <#1541738768468414484>.

**Who is eligible for rewards in the vibe/vibe incentivized testnet?**
Users & builders, check <#1545385768753569823> for details

**Are product ideas enough for testnet reward eligibility?**
No. Utility/RWA/vibecoded projects need an MVP, demo, usable flow, or working testnet simulation. Meme/artcoin projects need visible culture effort.

**How can I ask for support?**
Use <#1544666860744744990> for launch questions. Use <#1541737670072340596> only for private or sensitive issues.

**Is allocation guaranteed?**
No. Participation will be considered for eligibility, but final rewards depend on activity, quality, and review.

**How to launch my project on testnet?**
1. Go to https://testnet.vibevibe.fun/create
2. Set up launch & token details, enter all the information available, set up your initial buy and the payout wallet. Read the instructions carefully. Supply, target, allocation, and shape cannot change after creation
3. Once the bonding curve is complete, the token is graduated to DEX

**Can I launch more than one project?**
Yes, but more launches do not automatically mean better reward-related eligibility.

**What counts as good project for the testnet campaign?**
See <#1545385768753569823> 

**How can I participate in the testnet as a user?**
0. Add Robinhood Testnet Chain to your EVM wallet at https://faucet.testnet.chain.robinhood.com/add-chain
1. Go to https://testnet.vibevibe.fun/
2. Discover testnet projects, use your testnet funds to trade tokens
